rationale: Quantum mechanics is an entire physical theory, not a bounded formalization task.
Percentage is ordinary notation for division by one hundred rather than a bounded missing Mathlib abstraction.
Classical mechanics is a whole physical discipline, not one bounded formalization task.
Kinematics is a whole branch of mechanics, not one bounded formalization task.
String theory is a whole physical theory, not one bounded formalization task.
Point depends on the chosen geometry and representation; this article-level concept is not a bounded Mathlib target.
Theorem is a generic category, not a particular proposition to formalize.
Euclid's Elements is a historical work containing many results, not one bounded mathematical object or statement.
Mathematical constant is a category covering many unrelated constants, not one bounded formalization target.
Nicolas Bourbaki is an author collective, not a mathematical object or statement.
A slide rule is a physical calculating instrument rather than a mathematical object or statement.
Mathematical model is a generic category whose formal content depends on a particular modeled system.
The On-Line Encyclopedia of Integer Sequences is a database, not a mathematical object or statement.
Nonlinear programming names an optimization field and family of problems rather than one bounded formalization target.
Computer algebra system denotes a category of software systems rather than a mathematical object or statement.
Indian mathematics is a historical and cultural body of work rather than one bounded mathematical target.
Ratio ranges from ordinary division to ratios of quantities and needs a narrower target before formalization.
